subject: Request: Trial extension and promo credit due to build queue backlog
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@quantbyte.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: QuantByte Platform Team <platform@quantbyte.io>
Date: 2028-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Trial extension — stalled build queue during DB migration

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from our side — we hit an unexpected blocker this morning during a vendor-led DB migration. The migration changed a handful of schemas and our connector is failing in the build queue with repeated 502s. Engineering has the fix in a branch but because of our CI/CD window and the backlog, we won't be able to get a verified build into the POC environment for ~3–4 weeks.

We're in the middle of the Redwood trial and had planned to do a live demo for execs next week, but obviously that's not happening while we triage. Can you help with two things:

- A 30-day trial extension so our team has time to re-run integration tests and confirm the fix; and
- A short promo credit (estimate ~50k token-equivalent) to cover the extra token usage from reruns and debug logs while we stabilize.

I've attached the build logs and a screenshot of the 502. We're hopeful this is a temporary hiccup — we really like Redwood and want to keep momentum. Happy to jump on a quick call with your engineering contact to walk through the logs.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
CTO, QuantByte

Attachments: build-queue-log-20280821.txt (text), error-502-snapshot.png (image)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-22T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Trial extension — stalled build queue during DB migration

Ben / Karthik — forwarding QuantByte's ask. Short summary: external vendor DB migration introduced schema drift; their connector is producing 502s in build; they estimate a 3–4 week delay to get a verified build. Request is for a 30-day extension + ~50k token promo credit to cover debugging.

Why this matters: QuantByte is mid-POC, showing an enterprise analytics workflow; they were scheduled for an executive demo next week. We should keep momentum — losing the demo risks the deal.

Suggested motion: 30-day trial extension + 30k–50k promo credit (we can adjust after SRE triage). Karthik, can you confirm whether our SRE/solutions team can do a focused 30–45 minute debug session tomorrow? If they can't, we should stick to the extension + credits.

If you approve, I'll send a customer-facing note and log the change in HubSpot (deal QB-2028-08-22-POC).

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-22T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Trial extension — stalled build queue during DB migration

Marissa — thanks for the ping. I agree we should protect momentum here. Quick thoughts:

- I'm comfortable approving a 30-day extension.
- For promo credits, let's be conservative: approve a one-time 30k token promo credit now; we can top up if engineering confirms heavier usage.
- Please log the change in HubSpot (deal QB-2028-08-22-POC) and mark it as sales-assisted; I'll note it on the opportunity.

If Karthik's team can join a debug call tomorrow and reduce time-to-fix, that will help justify any additional credit later.

On another note — can we capture the failure mode in a short KB entry so we can triage similar vendor migrations faster? Karthik, happy to collaborate.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

On Tue, Aug 22, 2028 at 10:07 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Ben / Karthik — forwarding QuantByte's ask. Short summary: external vendor DB migration introduced schema drift; their connector is producing 502s in build; they estimate a 3–4 week delay to get a verified build. Request is for a 30-day extension + ~50k token promo credit to cover debugging.
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-22T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Trial extension — stalled build queue during DB migration

Thanks — I approve a 30-day extension and the 30k promo credit (one-time). Please do the following when you communicate it to the customer:

- Apply the 30-day trial extension to QuantByte's account (note original trial expiry in HubSpot).
- Apply a 30,000 token promo credit tied to deal QB-2028-08-22-POC; flag in billing so it doesn't auto-expire.
- Open a support ticket and schedule a 45-minute technical deep-dive next week (include Karthik and Marissa).
- Add a short KB entry after the call summarizing the vendor migration failure mode.

I want to keep this as a one-off concession unless we see a pattern of repeated migration-related asks. Good candidate for CS/SE handoff if they recover.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

> - For promo credits, let's be conservative: approve a one-time 30k token promo credit now; we can top up if engineering confirms heavier usage.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@quantbyte.io>
Cc: QuantByte Platform Team <platform@quantbyte.io>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-23T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Trial extension — stalled build queue during DB migration

Hi Elena — thanks for sending the logs.

Good news: we approved a 30-day trial extension and have applied a one-time 30,000 token promo credit to your account tied to deal QB-2028-08-22-POC. You should see the extension reflected in the console; the promo will appear in billing as a manual adjustment and not auto-apply to future invoices.

Next steps:
- I've created support ticket #RB-9873 and scheduled a 45-minute troubleshooting session with Karthik and our solutions team on Thursday 2028-08-24 at 09:30 PT. Please confirm if that time works for your engineers.
- We'll review the attached build log and the integration-plan-diff.pdf on the call and aim to get a hotfix into CI the same day.
- If we see token consumption exceed the promo during the debugging window, escalate to Ben and I for an emergency top-up decision.

Appreciate your patience — we want to make this POC a win.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: integration-plan-diff.pdf (PDF)
Related: https://hubspot.company/contacts/QUANT-1284 | Support ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/RB-9873
